limitations: Every conclusion is advisory; no tags, values, priors, mechanism, thresholds or source registry changed.
Only a bounded primary-source pass. No matched live-cell kinetic set or covariance is inferred; source errors do not become priors.
Candidates lacking frozen OK identity remain ineligible even when a primary numerical value was found. Identity OK alone is not quantitative claim or transfer validation.
Card count is an organizational count, not independent experiments. AK08 extends P20, AK10 traces P21, AK11 reuses P19; no double counting.
Concentration inputs were handled separately. This packet does not reinterpret concentration denominators or create a joint equilibrium from separate studies.
Static code comparison is conditional on the recorded source and template. Switch0 is a template fact, not verification of runtime configuration.
Raw full articles remain in ignored local-only caches. Distributed packet contains compact factual paraphrases and metadata; no redistributed full text.

primary_reviews.target_transfer_caveat: In-vitro labeled muscle actin and high phosphate are transferred to generic cell chemistry. ATP constants in Table1 are cited from earlier work, not new data here.

primary_reviews.finding: The current association .21 and release .00202 are reported, but come from different setups. Association to formin-bound ends is .21 in setup1 and .08 in setup2. Release in setup2 is inferred from resumption of growth and competing fates. Figure 2c and Results also report nearly overlapping BFC-to-BF regrowth curves across the two setups, allowing CP exit to be inferred in both. The setup distinction alone is not evidence of contradictory release kinetics.

measured_or_model_context.buffer: 50mM KCl,5mM Tris pH7.8,.2mM ATP,1mM MgCl2,.2mM EGTA,10mM DTT,1mM DABCO; typical1uM actin/4uM profilin.
measured_or_model_context.denominator: CP binding a formin-bearing end; release from a ternary end, not free-end uncapping.

primary_reviews.target_transfer_caveat: Do not treat the current pair as one fitted pair or interpret setup differences as a statistical interval.

derivation_assumptions: Exponential survival and competing CP/formin exit partition; resumption identifies fate indirectly.

parameters.name: actin_chem.cofilin_decorated_fraction

declaration.source: the fraction of built filament subunits carrying cofilin. THIS ROW STANDS IN FOR BINDING KINETICS THAT ARE NOT WIRED: no cofilin binding row exists in this file (nor on codex/bio-wiring-20260915, whose cofilin path is a 64-row molecular G/F preparation that is not ported), so the decoration cannot be computed from the file and is DECLARED. Sized from stoichiometry and from what cofilin does in a resting cell, not from any gate: one cofilin per actin protomer against actin_chem.cofilin_conc 20 uM and the filament this spec builds puts the hard ceiling at 0.0987 on the shipped build (1.021e7 molecules against 1.035e8 built protomers; cell/severing.decorated_fraction_ceiling recomputes it from the BUILT protomer count and refuses anything above it, with both counts in the message); and most cofilin in a resting cell is Ser3-phosphorylated and cannot bind F-actin at all, so the resting decoration sits well under that ceiling. 0.05 is an order-of-magnitude EXAMPLE inside it and a PI-GAP inference target, not a measurement. WARNING the real law (Kadzik 2026, aleph/laws/cofilin_severing.py) severs at decorated/bare BOUNDARIES and peaks at INTERMEDIATE decoration, while the uniform-rate form this row feeds is monotone in it — no run may claim the occupancy dependence. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

parameters.review_note: Declared occupancy placeholder; finite stoichiometric ceiling is not binding kinetics.

parameters.name: actin_chem.end_segment_band_hi

declaration.source: upper edge of the end segment's rest-length band, in multiples of the family's seg (L0): above it a dormant node is inserted at the midpoint (growth-wiring §4). 2.0 x L0 sits exactly on fluid.spacing_factor (EXAMPLE 2.0), so the fluid still sees the end segment (directive 6)

parameters.review_note: Rest-length discretization bands; biological measurement status does not apply.

parameters.name: actin_chem.end_segment_band_lo

declaration.source: lower edge of the end segment's rest-length band, in multiples of the family's seg (L0): below it the end node is retired to the pool (DESIGN-2026-09-08-growth-wiring §4, actin-chemistry §2.2). end_growth refuses unless lo < hi/2 and monomer_rise <= (hi - lo) x L0

parameters.review_note: Rest-length discretization bands; biological measurement status does not apply.

parameters.name: actin_chem.severing_reserve_fraction

declaration.source: spare CHAIN records per built chain, because a cut makes two chains of one and the chain count is fixed at construction (the same device as <pop>.dormant_fraction for nodes). DERIVED from the rows beside it, not tuned: cofilin_severing_rate 0.01 /(um.s) x cofilin_decorated_fraction 0.05 x cortex.contour 3.0 um = 1.5e-3 cuts per chain per second, so the longest declared run (100 s) needs 0.15 records per chain and 0.5 carries that with 3.3x headroom. A run that outlives it SATURATES and the step is counted (physics/chain_split no_record), never raised. Each record costs two dead segment rows and NO node. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

parameters.review_note: Storage headroom derived from declared rate×occupancy×contour×duration and selected headroom factor; not an empirical stoichiometry.

relations.expression_or_dependency: Measured reaction4 loss + elongation-versus-profilin curves → Eq4 affinity fit; association4 = loss4 / Kd4.
source_inputs: Elongation curves and literature reaction1/2 constants
source_outputs: Fitted reaction3 tip affinity and reaction4 affinity
assumptions_and_limits: Independent fits for nucleotide conditions; AMP-PNP surrogate.
ADP fit selected for positive affinities; association upper limit.
Individual affinity constants are less identifiable than their ratio. No current input covariance inferred.

relations.expression_or_dependency: k_observed = k_off_CP + k_off_formin; fraction_BF = k_off_CP / k_observed.
source_inputs: Fractions resuming rapid growth or detaching
source_outputs: Inferred CP and formin exit rates for setup2
assumptions_and_limits: Exponential exit and fate identification; CP departure is inferred.
Current association .21 comes from setup1, so no matched current on/off fit is asserted.

Figure 2c and Results also report nearly overlapping BFC-to-BF regrowth curves across the two setups, allowing CP exit to be inferred in both. The setup distinction alone is not evidence of contradictory release kinetics.

relations.expression_or_dependency: K_d_kinetic = k_off_timecourse / k_on; equilibrium Kd is fitted separately.
source_outputs: Kinetic Kd .8±.1uM for WT AEDANS assay
assumptions_and_limits: Apparent one-step binding interpretation; timecourse off chosen because intercept off not resolved.
Current2uM Kd comes from a different source comparison, not this ratio.

relations.expression_or_dependency: Critical-concentration shifts + 1:1 nonpolymerizable Tβ4–actin sequestration model → equilibrium Kd estimates.
source_inputs: Polymerization/critical-concentration data at specified Tβ4 levels
source_outputs: Separate ATP and ADP equilibrium-affinity estimates
assumptions_and_limits: Experiments/protocols differ; listed values are not one uncertainty distribution.
No joint fit or covariance with Au association constants.

relations.expression_or_dependency: In the high-profilin-affinity limit, maximal growth velocity = k_minus2; growth curve identifies maximal velocity and Michaelis constant.
assumptions_and_limits: Same paper/evidence lineage as pinned P20.
Other reaction constants cannot all be recovered; detailed balance cannot be established by growth curves alone.

relations.expression_or_dependency: ADP-Pi affinity := ATP affinity for each binder.
assumptions_and_limits: Published model equivalence, not experimental equality.
No independent parameter or independent evidence count.

relations.expression_or_dependency: For each nucleotide and binder: soluble k_off = shared k_on × nucleotide-specific Kd.
assumptions_and_limits: Rates and affinities originate in different experiments/species/conditions.
Static construction is not evidence of matched detailed balance or actual runtime usage.

relations.expression_or_dependency: Tip profilin k_on(nt) = shared profilin_tip_k_off / profilin_tip_kd(nt).
assumptions_and_limits: Different assays, species preparations and nucleotide conditions; source cycle compatibility unverified.
No replacement values, detailed-balance enforcement or current same-fit assertion.

relations.expression_or_dependency: Current per-length cut coefficient = declared severing rate × declared decorated fraction; storage reserve follows declared cut-rate×contour×duration plus selected headroom.
assumptions_and_limits: Current occupancy law is not derived from source decorated/bare-boundary data.
Raw source explicitly calls this a placeholder. Storage capacity is not a measured biochemical parameter.

relations.expression_or_dependency: ADP dissociation rate → effective ADP-to-ATP exchange only when ATP rebinding is rapid.
